inputs.text: South Dakota is right to insist that its own state elections be decided by citizens. Senate Bill 175 is a modest safeguard: it applies to new registrants and state elections, not as some sweeping disruption. Self-government depends on clear rules and confidence in the ballot. Protecting that principle is basic civic responsibility, not an extreme measure.
